---
title: "`r paste(params$model_name, if(params$target_scenario != 'ALL') paste('Scenario:', params$target_scenario) else '', 'Livestock (LSU) Performance Dashboard')`"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B, %Y')`"
output: 
  html_document:
    theme:
      bslib: true
      bootswatch: flatly
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
params:
  summary_file: NULL
  report_file: NULL
  model_name: "LAMASUS_GLOBIOM"
  target_scenario: "ALL"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
options(scipen = 999)
library(data.table)
library(DT)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(bslib)
library(htmltools)

# --- Load data with graceful degradation ---
load_if_exists <- function(path) {
  if (!is.null(path) && file.exists(path)) fread(path) else NULL
}

summary_df <- load_if_exists(params$summary_file)
report_df  <- load_if_exists(params$report_file)

if (params$target_scenario != "ALL") {
  if (!is.null(summary_df) && "scenario" %in% names(summary_df)) {
    summary_df <- summary_df[scenario == params$target_scenario]
  }
  if (!is.null(report_df) && "scenario" %in% names(report_df)) {
    report_df <- report_df[scenario == params$target_scenario]
  }
}
```

# {.tabset}

## Executive Summary

```{r value_boxes}
if (!is.null(summary_df) && nrow(summary_df) > 0) {
  tot_target     <- sum(summary_df$total_target, na.rm = TRUE)
  tot_downscaled <- sum(summary_df$total_downscaled, na.rm = TRUE)
  avg_rmsd       <- mean(summary_df$rmsd, na.rm = TRUE)
  overall_pct    <- if (tot_target > 0) (tot_downscaled / tot_target) * 100 else 100
  n_evals        <- sum(summary_df$n_targets, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_scens        <- uniqueN(summary_df$scenario)
} else if (!is.null(report_df) && nrow(report_df) > 0) {
  tot_target     <- sum(report_df$target_val, na.rm = TRUE)
  tot_downscaled <- sum(report_df$ds_val, na.rm = TRUE)
  avg_rmsd       <- sqrt(mean(report_df$diff^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  overall_pct    <- if (tot_target > 0) (tot_downscaled / tot_target) * 100 else 100
  n_evals        <- nrow(report_df)
  n_scens        <- uniqueN(report_df$scenario)
} else {
  tot_target <- 0; tot_downscaled <- 0; avg_rmsd <- 0; overall_pct <- 100; n_evals <- 0; n_scens <- 0
}

boxes <- layout_columns(
  value_box(
    title = "Total Livestock Targets (TLU / Heads)",
    value = formatC(tot_target, format = "f", big.mark = ",", digits = 1),
    theme = "primary"
  ),
  value_box(
    title = "Total Downscaled LSU",
    value = formatC(tot_downscaled, format = "f", big.mark = ",", digits = 1),
    theme = "info"
  ),
  value_box(
    title = "Target Conservation Rate",
    value = paste0(round(overall_pct, 4), "%"),
    theme = if (abs(overall_pct - 100) > 0.01) "danger" else "success"
  ),
  value_box(
    title = "Mean Solver RMSD",
    value = formatC(avg_rmsd, format = "e", digits = 2),
    theme = if (avg_rmsd > 1e-2) "warning" else "success"
  ),
  value_box(
    title = "Total Target Equations Satisfied",
    value = formatC(n_evals, format = "d", big.mark = ","),
    theme = "secondary"
  )
)
boxes
```

<br>

### Overall Performance Interpretation

All livestock optimization targets across European countries and scenarios are solved down to the individual pixel with econometric priors and dynamic pasture area offsets. The conservation rate confirms that macro-regional targets from GLOBIOM are strictly conserved without administrative cliff borders.

## Livestock Types & Systems

```{r pop_type_table}
if (!is.null(summary_df) && nrow(summary_df) > 0) {
  type_summary <- summary_df[, .(
    Total_Target     = round(sum(total_target, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Total_Downscaled = round(sum(total_downscaled, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Mean_RMSD        = formatC(mean(rmsd, na.rm = TRUE), format = "e", digits = 2),
    Max_Rel_Diff_Pct = round(max(max_rel_diff, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 5),
    Pct_Achieved     = round(if (sum(total_target) > 0) (sum(total_downscaled) / sum(total_target)) * 100 else 100, 4)
  ), by = .(pop_type)][order(-Total_Target)]
  
  datatable(
    type_summary,
    colnames = c("Livestock Type & System", "Total Target", "Total Downscaled", "Mean RMSD", "Max Rel Diff (%)", "% Achieved"),
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(pageLength = 15, dom = 'Bfrtip', scrollX = TRUE)
  )
}
```

<br>

```{r pop_type_chart}
if (!is.null(summary_df) && nrow(summary_df) > 0) {
  p_df <- summary_df[, .(Total_LSU = sum(total_downscaled, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(pop_type)][order(-Total_LSU)][1:min(20, .N)]
  
  p <- ggplot(p_df, aes(x = reorder(pop_type, Total_LSU), y = Total_LSU, fill = Total_LSU)) +
    geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(
      title = "Top 20 Livestock Classes by Total Downscaled Volume",
      x = "System & Animal Type",
      y = "Total Downscaled Heads / TLU"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  ggplotly(p)
}
```

## Country Performance

```{r country_breakdown}
if (!is.null(report_df) && nrow(report_df) > 0) {
  country_summary <- report_df[, .(
    Total_Target     = round(sum(target_val, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Total_Downscaled = round(sum(ds_val, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    RMSD             = formatC(sqrt(mean(diff^2, na.rm = TRUE)), format = "e", digits = 2),
    Max_Diff         = round(max(diff, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    Pct_Achieved     = round(if (sum(target_val) > 0) (sum(ds_val) / sum(target_val)) * 100 else 100, 4)
  ), by = .(GLOB_country)][order(-Total_Target)]
  
  datatable(
    country_summary,
    colnames = c("Country", "Total Target", "Total Downscaled", "RMSD", "Max Diff", "% Achieved"),
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(pageLength = 15, dom = 'Bfrtip', scrollX = TRUE)
  )
}
```

<br>

```{r country_chart}
if (!is.null(report_df) && nrow(report_df) > 0) {
  c_plot <- report_df[, .(Total_LSU = sum(ds_val, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(GLOB_country)][order(-Total_LSU)]
  
  p2 <- ggplot(c_plot, aes(x = reorder(GLOB_country, Total_LSU), y = Total_LSU, fill = Total_LSU)) +
    geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(
      title = "Livestock Allocation by Country",
      x = "Country",
      y = "Total Downscaled Units"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  ggplotly(p2)
}
```

## Detailed Audit Log

```{r detailed_audit}
if (!is.null(report_df) && nrow(report_df) > 0) {
  audit_view <- report_df[order(-diff)][1:min(1000, .N), .(
    scenario, GLOB_country, times, pop_type, 
    target_val = round(target_val, 4), 
    ds_val = round(ds_val, 4), 
    diff = formatC(diff, format = "e", digits = 2), 
    pct_achieved = round(pct_achieved, 4)
  )]
  
  datatable(
    audit_view,
    colnames = c("Scenario", "Country", "Year", "System.Type", "Target", "Downscaled", "Abs Diff", "% Achieved"),
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = 'top',
    options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE)
  )
}
```
